name: The Crooked
title: The Twisted
description: Nothing about The Crooked sits level. One side pulls the floor while the other holds the balance point; a two-footed hinge resets the line just long enough to trust it. Then a single arm cleans, presses, and drives the bell overhead alone. Suitcase Deadlift, Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift, Romanian Deadlift, Single-Arm Clean, Single-Arm Press, Single-Arm Thruster — three reps each, the same six-step twist every round. It doesn't test whether you're strong. It tests whether your strong side has been quietly covering for the other one.
